name: Pizzeria Bianco
headsUp: I am definitely biased in every way because I love Chris personally, but so does every other person in the pizza world...
teaser: The original artisan pizzeria that changed pizza itself. If you haven't made the pilgrimage you are hereby commanded to do so.
address: 623 E Adams St, Phoenix, AZ 85004, USA
review:
Chris Bianco is probably the most famous pizzaiolo/pizza chef in America, and 2007 his food changed my life. I had never tasted such amazing flavor and balance in a pizza before; not only were the carefully-sourced ingredients incredible, but together they were even better. I remember thinking, "if pizza can be this good...then what about other food?"

Flash forward 20 years and a lot has changed. Bianco used to have one location, the lines used to be 4 hours long, and he used to make every pizza himself. Now he's got a multiple spots, you can get reservations or walk-in fairly easy, and he's got an amazing team that in some cases have been with him for decades. It's still great pizza that you owe it to yourself to experience.

Should you still go if you have access to Pizzeria Bianco in Los Angeles? Absolutely. Bianco started his career making cheese and the Phoenix locations make their own cheese, and it happens to be my favorite mozzarella in the country.
